name: live-browser-mcp
description: Control a persistent real Chromium browser in GitHub Codespaces through authenticated MCP tools and a private live desktop.

interface.longDescription: Open websites, read rendered pages, click and type, manage tabs and capture screenshots using one persistent Chromium context. Human login and security checks use a private Codespaces live desktop. Runtime availability depends on the Codespace.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open a website in my live browser and read what is visible.
